method_note: Official online program of the 48th AAS GN&C Conference (Breckenridge, 30 Jan-4 Feb 2026): 17 technical sessions (S01-S17) containing 103 AAS papers (AAS-26-xxx); the S18 poster session (7 papers), tutorials/workshops and the separate classified session were excluded. Weights are paper-weighted within the session structure (each session's papers split across at most 2 keywords). Keywords below 0.02 omitted (space-propulsion 0.019), so weights sum slightly below 1. deployable-structures added 2026-10-16: paper titles of the 17 technical sessions were screened; 1 paper on the in-flight deployment of NISAR's large reflector (S17) fits, weight = 1/103 = 0.0097, taken 0.5/0.5 from spacecraft-gnc and space-systems (the S17 split), so the sum is unchanged; kept although below the 0.02 cutoff. Not counted: tensegrity-based formation control (a control concept, not a structure) and solar-sail trajectory papers.
